title: A presentation with free conormal module can be changed so that the relations form a basis of the conormal module (Huber)
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $S$ a finitely presented $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Assume that there are $n\ge0$ and a surjective homomorphism of $R$-algebras $R[x_1,\dots,x_n]\to S$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] whose kernel $I$ has conormal module $I/I^2$ (an $S$-module) free as an $S$-module. Then there are integers $m,c\ge0$, polynomials $f_1,\dots,f_c\in R[y_1,\dots,y_m]$ and an isomorphism of $R$-algebras $R[y_1,\dots,y_m]/(f_1,\dots,f_c)\cong S$ such that, with $J=(f_1,\dots,f_c)$, the $S$-module $J/J^2$ is free with basis the classes $f_1\bmod J^2,\dots,f_c\bmod J^2$.
